items.name: Locke Publishes Two Treatises of Government
items.why: The specific source of natural rights and government by consent; would influence american-declaration directly and be part_of age-of-enlightenment.

items.name: Montesquieu Publishes The Spirit of the Laws
items.why: The separation of powers; would influence french-revolution-declaration (Article 16) and founding-of-united-states, part_of age-of-enlightenment.

items.name: Rousseau Publishes The Social Contract
items.why: The general will and popular sovereignty; would influence french-revolution-declaration (Articles 3 and 6), part_of age-of-enlightenment.
